chat_work_handoff_contract.chat_freeze_rule: After all predictions are frozen and the binding plus access execution receipt are verified, transition from PREDICTION to POST_PREDICTION_HANDOFF. Only then create exactly one GitHub Issue using issue_title and CHAT-WORK-PREDICTION-HANDOFF-V2. Copy binding exactly and preserve the complete prediction rows. This one GITHUB_CREATE_ISSUE call is the only Chat-side GitHub write allowed; all other Git writes remain denied.

serialization_constraints.decisive_rule_ablation_rule: Provide exactly one decisive_rule_ablations row for every rule_attribution.decisive_rule_ids entry; removing that rule must change Top1, or reclassify it as supporting before freeze.
serialization_constraints.fractional_confidence_normalization: A numeric float from 0.0 through 1.0 is deterministically converted to the nearest integer percent before validation.
serialization_constraints.overall_confidence_cap_rule: overall_confidence must not exceed the weakest of the other eight confidence components.
serialization_constraints.preflight_rule: CHAT applies the deterministic serialization rules embedded here, then after complete freeze and binding/receipt verification enters POST_PREDICTION_HANDOFF and creates exactly one Issue through the GitHub connector. The GitHub controller performs authoritative normalization and full validation, including fractional confidence conversion, rule-ledger status enforcement, compact serialization, binding checks, receipt checks, and size checks. No local gh, clone, Python, or terminal command is required. Keep every required field and every substantive evidence row, deduplicate repeated prose, and shorten wording toward 40000 characters. Evidence completeness takes priority up to 60000 characters. Never split one handoff across Issues, remove ranking-changing evidence, or change Top1 or Top2 to meet the preferred budget.
serialization_constraints.reversal_test_consistency_rule: Derive top1_survives by comparing ranking_before with ranking_after_removal; never copy the template placeholder.
serialization_constraints.rule_status_normalization: CHALLENGED rules are automatically moved out of decisive/supporting roles into counterevidence. RETIRED or suppressed rules fail closed.
serialization_constraints.track_evidence_partition_rule: Within each Ziwei or Bazi track, supporting_evidence_ids and contradicting_evidence_ids must be disjoint. Evidence that supports Top1 by contradicting a rival remains supporting evidence for Top1.

chat_work_handoff_contract.work_acceptance_rule: Read the unique open handoff Issue for binding.round_id; never reconstruct predictions from conversation memory. Validate every binding value against this current bundle and stop before scoring if the receipt is missing, duplicated, stale, or mismatched.

rule_application_policy.ATTRIBUTION: Classify every applied rule as decisive, supporting, or counterevidence. Removing a decisive rule must change Top1.
rule_application_policy.CANDIDATE: Use only when scope matches; never as sole evidence.
rule_application_policy.CHALLENGED: Treat as a warning or counter-hypothesis, not a decisive rule.
rule_application_policy.EVIDENCE_STOP_RULE: There is no evidence quota. Stop only after every option's required and distinctive atoms are marked supported, contradicted, or unknown; every rival has been compared with Top1; and no unread declared source section is reasonably capable of changing the ordering. Otherwise expand retrieval. Unknowns remain explicit and cap confidence.
rule_application_policy.PROVISIONAL: Use as a low-weight hypothesis and never as sole evidence.
rule_application_policy.VALIDATED: May be used normally within its declared scope.

startup_sequence.binding_rule: After loading training/state.json and chat-input/current.json, require the embedded prediction_access_contract to exactly equal this bootstrap contract before any further repository retrieval.

prediction_output_contract.blind_before_options_rule: Complete blind_chart_model without option text or option-derived events before building question_semantic_model and option comparisons.
prediction_output_contract.confidence_calibration_rule: If actor, exact time, mechanism, or real-world endpoint is unresolved, cap confidence at 65. Forced relative choices are not high-confidence factual claims.
prediction_output_contract.failure_learning_rule: After reveal, classify the root cause and choose one V3 remediation type. Only NEW_GENERAL_RULE may add catalog rules; execution, measurement, calibration, weighting, scope, merge, retirement, tests, and hypotheses are valid non-rule corrections.
prediction_output_contract.severe_atom_binding_rule: If Top1 contains severe, irreversible, or high-precision atoms, set severe_atoms_have_independent_evidence=true only when every such atom is copied exactly into supports_option_atoms as '<OPTION_ID>:<EXACT_ATOM_TEXT>' on at least one INDEPENDENT evidence row. General option support, a different atom, or a shared scene does not qualify. Preflight never derives this flag.
prediction_output_contract.tagging_rule: Classify every question before reveal using only its stem/options and the no-answer chart. Use only taxonomy values. List a rule in applied_rule_ids only when it materially affects the frozen reasoning; unrelated questions do not validate that rule. Select no more than 6 scope-matched rules from question_execution_routes and the compiled runtime model. A CHALLENGED rule may appear only as counterevidence.

runtime_performance_contract.goal: Reduce connection failures and repeated work without reducing predictive coverage or changing evidence standards.
runtime_performance_contract.guardrail: Any optimization that omits a non-negotiable reasoning theme, removes ranking-changing evidence, skips a rival comparison, merges Ziwei and Bazi before independent sealing, or converts an unknown endpoint into a fact must fail closed.

interruption_recovery.resume_rule: Re-read current main binding and hashes, reuse visible completed-stage summaries when still matched, and rerun only unresolved stages plus final consistency. Never infer a completed final freeze from an interrupted response.

retrieval.first_pass: Use the routed knowledge-card anchors and case-shared chart structures.
retrieval.stop_rule: Stop only when every option atom is supported, contradicted, or explicitly unknown; Top1 has been compared with every rival; the strongest reversal has been run; and further declared-source retrieval is not reasonably capable of changing the ordering.
